features.title: Spiritual connection
features.text: Mystics draw divine, occult or primal magic from their connection. They can bond with up to ten other creatures and sense when those companions need help.

features.title: Vitality network
features.text: Transfer healing from a shared reserve to yourself or a bonded ally. The reserve replenishes each turn in combat and refills when you Refocus.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2–4 → 2.5–4.5. Connection and spell choices vary between offensive casting and dedicated support.
ratings.defense: 2 → 2.5–3.5. Eight HP and defensive choices help, but resources spent protecting oneself compete with allies.
ratings.support: 5 → 4–5. The vitality network and spells make healing and party sustain defining strengths.
ratings.utility: 4 → 3.5–4.5. Connection and spell tradition shape noncombat flexibility.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Manage network healing, spell resources and connections.
